name: Agile
effect:
The multiple attack penalty you take with this weapon is -4 per attack instead of -5.
The penalty on Reactive Strikes is 1 less.

name: Aiming Focus
effect: You can use the Guide Cast action to cast Attack spells at greater range.

name: Aquatic
flavor: This weapon is well suited for fighting underwater.
effect: You don't suffer any penalties for attacking underwater with the weapon.

name: Area
effect: Area spells affect multiple tiles in a area

name: Attack
effect:
An ability with this trait involves an attack. You subtract your current multiple attack penalty from your roll.
Afterwards, your multiple attack penalty increases, by 5 by default (though many traits and abilities change this).

name: Attunement
effect: An attunement action uses your innate connection to an aspect of magic and can only be used by creatures with an attunement.

name: Aura
flavor: This action involves the user's aura.
effect: Golems and other creatures without a Soul or a Mana Well can't take Aura actions.

name: Bayonet
effect:
Bayonets are fastened to runegun rifles, and provide a quick melee attack.
Their construction means you have a -1 penalty on attacks with them.

name: Blade Art
flavor: Blade Arts are attacks that break the limits of the mundane.
effect: Blade Arts are not spells and are not affected by modifiers that affect spells. They are magical effects, and they cost mana to use.

name: Block (X)
effect: While holding this weapon you have the Block action, which provides X defense.

name: Brawling
effect:
You can't attempt Brawling actions on creatures more than one size larger than you.
If you attempt a Brawling action on a creature one size larger than you, it gets a +4 bonus on its Save.
If you attempt a Brawling action on a smaller creature, you get a +1 bonus for each size it is smaller than you.

name: Channeling
effect:
You can still perform somatic components with a hand holding a channeling weapon.
You may cast touch spells at the range of this weapon.

name: Complex
flavor: Complex spells are harder to cast, requiring great magical skill.
effect: The spellshaping DC increase by 3.

name: Conjured Weapon
flavor: The spell creates a weapon out of magic that you can use while you maintain the spell.
effect: Your proffiency with a conjure weapon equals your proffiency with the spell or the weapon group of conjured weapons, whichever is higher.

name: Creature
effect: Actions with the Creature trait can only be taken by creatures, not player characters.

name: Deadly (dX)
effect: Critical hits with this weapon deal an additional X damage.

name: Defensive
flavor: This action or spell is defensive in nature, based around protection the user or their allies.

name: Dimensional
flavor: The spell has to do with shaping or manipulating dimensional rifts and extradimensional spaces.

name: Disarm
effect: You may take the Disarm action with this weapon, using its range and the attack bonus you have with it

name: Draining
flavor: Draining spells require a lot of mana
effect: Increase the spell's mana cost by twice its rank.

name: Enchantment
flavor: The spell temporarily improves the you or target, or gives them new abilities.

name: Environmental
flavor: The spell affects a large area, causing an effect on the environment.

name: Exploration
effect: Actions with the Exploration trait take longer than 1 minute and can't be done in combat.

name: Extend (X)
effect:
When you Strike you can extend your weapon's range to X as part of the Strike.
While extended you have a -2 move speed penalty and cannot make Reactive Strikes until you take an interact action to retract it.

name: Finesse
effect:
You can use your DEX instead of PHY when making attacks with this weapon.
PHY is still added to the damage roll (even if it's negative).

name: Golem
effect: Actions with the golem trait can only be taken by golems

name: Grab
effect: If your next action after hitting a creature with this attack is the Grapple Technique, it neither counts toward your multiple attack penalty nor applies it.

name: Healing
flavor: Healing actions restore health to living creatures.
effect: Healing effects have no effect on constructs.

name: Heavy
effect: Small or Tiny creatures have disadvantage on attacks with this weapon.

name: Illusion
flavor: The spell creates an illusory shape to fool visual observers.

name: Improved Grab
effect: If your next action after hitting a creature with this attack is the Grapple Technique, it costs no action and neither counts toward your multiple attack penalty nor applies it.

name: Innate
effect: You use your WIL instead of PHY when making attack and damage rolls with this weapon.

name: Item
effect: Actions with the Item trait can only be done if you have the specified item.

name: Light
effect: You may attempt to hide a light weapon on your person as a Sleight of Hand action.

name: Loud
effect: Using this weapon creates a loud burst of noise.

name: Magazine (X)
effect:
Magazine weapons can be loaded with X ammo, and can fire that many times before needing to reload
Reloading still only reloads one ammo, so magazine weapons take multiple actions to fully reload.

name: Manipulation
flavor: Manipulation spells modify or shape matter. They are generally not cast in combat.

name: Move
flavor: This ability moves the user

name: Parry
effect: While holding this weapon you have the Parry action.

name: Precision
flavor: These attacks are very precise, allowing you to target creature weak points easier
effect: When targeting weak points the penalty is 2 lower than normal (to a minimum of 1).

name: Propulsive
effect: You add your PHY to the damage rolls of this weapon.

name: Psionic
effect: You use your INT instead of PHY when making attack and damage rolls with this weapon.

name: Ranged
effect:
You use your DEX instead of PHY when making attacks with this weapon.
No bonus is added to the damage of the weapon (unless it has Propulsive).

name: Ranged Trip
effect: Foes hit by this weapon must make a Fortitude saving throw or fall prone.

name: Rapid
effect:
The multiple attack penalty you take with this weapon is -3 per attack instead of -5.
The penalty on Reactive Strikes is 2 less.

name: Reload (X)
effect: After attacking you need to spend (X) interact actions to reload the weapon before you can fire again.

name: Sensing
flavor: The spell helps the caster detect creatures or objects.

name: Shove
effect: Creatures hit by this weapon must make a Fortitude saving throw or be pushed up to 1 tile in a direction of the attacker's choice.

name: Skill
effect: This action involves a skill check with the specified skill.

name: Slowing (X)
effect: Your move speed is reduced by X tiles when holding this weapon.

name: Sluggish
effect:
The multiple attack penalty you take with this weapon is -6 per attack instead of -5.
The penalty on Reactive Strikes is 1 more.

name: Spellcasting
flavor: This action involves casting a spell, and making a Spellshaping check.
effect:
You can use Somatic and Verbal components when casting spells.
This gives the action the Manipulate and Verbal traits, respectively.

name: Soul
flavor: The spell or ability targets or affects souls

name: Stance
effect: A stance is a style of fighting that stays active until you are knocked unconscious, you no longer meet its requirements, or you enter a new stance.

name: Sweep
effect: The multiple attack penalty you take with this weapon is -3 if the last attack was against a different target.

name: Swing Around
effect: You ignore half the bonus from cover and the Block action.

name: Tactical
effect:
Tactical actions are based on moving and giving orders to willing allies.
Your allies must be able to hear or see you and the target or destination of your order.

name: Targeting
flavor: Targeting spells fire one or multiple projectiles.
effect: You can make targeted attacks with the spell.

name: Teleportation
flavor: Allows the caster to instantly move to a new position.

name: Temporal
flavor: Deals with time, speeding up or slowing down objects or creatures.

name: Technique
flavor: Technique actions involve skilled maneuvers in combat.

name: Thrown (X)
effect: You can throw this weapon up to the specified range as a ranged attack.

name: Traverse
effect: When you take a Traverse action you can Swim, Climb, Fly, Glide or Burrow instead of Striding if you have those speeds

name: Trip
effect: You may take the Trip action with this weapon, using its range and the attack bonus you have with it

name: Unwieldy
effect: While attacking with this weapon you have a -3 penalty if the target is adjacent to you.

name: Verbal
effect: Using a verbal action involves speaking at least normal speaking volume, which may break Stealth

name: Versatile
effect: You can choose the damage type among those specified.

name: Volley (X)
effect: While attacking with this weapon you have a -3 penalty if the target is within X tiles
